summary: A flexible riverside evening combining festive lights, a Christmas-tree photo stop, dinner and shopping at ICONSIAM. Strong shortlist option if you already want a Chao Phraya outing; December 2026 installations and dates are not yet verified. Photos show the previous 2025 edition.
whyGo: Large illuminated installations against the river and skyline make an easy photography stop.
Combine outdoor atmosphere with indoor food, air conditioning and shopping rather than planning a whole day around lights.
Past editions paired Thai-inspired decoration with music and choreographed water features.
bestFor: A relaxed evening with dinner and river views
Visitors who enjoy polished festive shopping-centre displays
skipIf: You want a traditional neighbourhood festival or quiet riverside setting
You dislike crowds, amplified music or shopping malls
A special journey depends on guaranteed December 2026 performances
duration: Allow 1–2 hours for lights and a stroll; 2–4 hours including dinner and browsing.
cost: 2025 River Park illumination was free. December 2026 admission terms unannounced; pay separately for food, transport and any ticketed extras.
hours: Mall commonly listed as 10:00–22:00 daily; confirm current hours. Exact 2026 festive lighting and show times remain unknown.
bestTime: Arrive near sunset, then view the lights after dark. A weekday early evening should offer a calmer visit than a peak holiday weekend.
gettingThere: 299 Charoen Nakhon Road, Khlong San. Gold Line to Charoen Nakhon station is the straightforward rail option, connecting at Krung Thon Buri. Boats from Sathorn/Saphan Taksin provide a scenic arrival; check current fares and final departures rather than assuming a free shuttle.
booking: Ordinary mall access needs no advance reservation. Reserve a chosen river-view restaurant separately; 2026 performances or premium areas may have different rules.
accessibility: Indoor mall facilities offer breaks from heat and crowds. Confirm the step-free route to River Park and station with the venue; boat boarding and crowded riverfront areas may be less convenient for wheelchair users.
practicalTips: Eat before the busiest dinner period and keep time for transport queues.
Check the venue event listing shortly before travel; do not use last season’s fountain timetable as a confirmed schedule.
Combine with other river stops to justify the journey; rail is a useful return option.
decemberNotes: The official ONESIAM page titled “The Magical Celebration 2026” actually describes November–December 2025 and January 2026. It lists the 2025 riverside programme through 23 December, then a separate 27–31 December countdown. Those dates do not confirm December 2026 availability.
uncertainties: No December 2026 festive programme located as of research date.
2026 decoration design, performance times, access terms and boat fares need confirmation.
The official legacy transport URL redirected to the homepage, limiting direct verification of transport details.
